incidents.name: USD0PPSubVault deployer-key compromise and malicious upgrade
incidents.notes: No contract flaw: Zoth's deployer key held the UUPS upgrade authority for the USD0PPSubVaultUpgradeable proxy, and whoever obtained it called upgradeToAndCall() to install a self-authored implementation with an unrestricted withdraw(), emptying the vault 36 seconds later.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x82f3a039...e43e was created by Zoth deployer 0x3604582f56565d7060D73829FfB9EBD579218Dca (not the attack sender 0x3b33c5Cd...); the last of its seven Upgraded events, at block 22094140 in tx 0xb2335f7bf58abbcaa006d0a2bed7db2c64a5dabed56fb1759260adc012c49abe, installed the attacker's own implementation 0xc89d7894341e13d5067d003af5346b257d861f56 — so the mechanical code age of 36s measures the attacker's implementation, not Zoth's; this row is context only and never feeds the curve
